changelog:
- Advanced Real-Time AI Grounding: Overhauled Ask AI with dynamic multi-source intelligence (Google News, Bing News, DuckDuckGo Instant Fact API, and Wikipedia) and Year 2026 temporal grounding to eliminate hallucinations for current political leaders, elections, officeholders, and real-world queries.
- Dynamic Semantic Intent & Decoupling: General knowledge and out-of-the-box inquiries are automatically distinguished and decoupled from active webpage context with zero hardcoded constraints.
- Incognito Navigation Fix: Resolved private browsing session back-button bug to ensure previous pages and ad visits navigate back cleanly to prior session pages rather than abruptly jumping to the public start page.
- Performance & Stability: Enhanced local multi-source relevance scoring and offline forensic synthesis.
